areaMeasurement.measurementMethod: Transform each existing family and each actual CRS84 intersection/difference polygon to Albers and measure planar area. Transform preserves input vertices; no densification or geometry mutation. Projection of newly subdivided geographic edges can cause minute area-closure differences, which are not acceptance tolerances.
areaMeasurement.overlayMethod: GEOS polygon intersections of existing geographic polygon edges; actual polygon overlay, not bbox/centroid approximation.
areaMeasurement.planarComparison: CRS84 degree-squared ratios retained to compare like-for-like with the raw-family report. Ratios are geometric area shares, not statistical confidence or administrative proof.
areaMeasurement.projectionName: China-centered custom WGS84 Albers equal-area conic; no official CRS code claimed

scope: Union all existing delivered CHN cells for each original fine sourceFeatureId, including recorded game gains. Families remain whole. Seven source-free delivered cells are measured separately. No source outside current CHN is imported and no official or presentation parent is assigned.

sourceTemporalLimits.fine: The original metadata claims 2017, but original shapefile XML records append/dissolve processing in August 2021. The fixed file is mixed or uncertified vintage. It is used as an experimental county geometry reference for the 2020-01-01 game scenario, not certified 2020 or untouched 2017 administrative truth. No unverified change is backdated.
